facts.text: Earl, something under the ground is hungry. Grab the snacks from Chang's and get on the rocks.
facts.why: Val never says this and it is set in quote marks. The real film has Burt's 'Broke into the wrong goddamn rec room, didn't you, you bastard!' at the basement fight.
facts.fix: Broke into the wrong rec room, didn't you?
